about: Python oracle (rdflib 7.6.0 / pyshacl 0.40.2 / owlrl 7.6.2) vs the page engines in Node (N3.js 2.13.12 / Comunica rdfjs-lite 5.4.1 / shacl-engine 1.1.3), per job; and each real x3d_mcp tool call (7d3f1d5) vs the oracle job it mirrors. MISMATCH would mean an unexplained difference.

engine_limits.P1: shacl-engine 1.1.3 resolves sh:class / sh:targetClass through rdfs:subClassOf in the SHAPES graph: the page copies the data graph's subClassOf triples into the shapes graph (SHACL 1.0 defines SHACL instance through the data graph).
engine_limits.P2: shacl-engine 1.1.3 focusNode/value are PathList objects: read .term.
engine_limits.P10: one sh:sparql constraint per shape: the page splits shapes that carry several (see R1).
engine_limits.R1: shacl-engine 1.1.3: two sh:sparql constraints on one shape give a false result where the one-constraint control gives 0 (unsplit, vanilla shacl-engine reports false S5 ROUTE violations on all 10 bench scenes). Repro: build/shacl3/repro/R1_*.
engine_limits.R2: shacl-engine 1.1.3: sh:inversePath [ sh:oneOrMorePath p ] (and oneOrMorePath of an inverse) collects no value nodes: a false no-viewpoint Warning (station T4.6 try). Repro: build/shacl3/repro/R2_*.
engine_limits.R3: shacl-engine 1.1.3 + Comunica 5.4.1: GROUP BY in a SPARQL constraint with a pre-bound $this errors: the page drops those constraints (x3d-core bench) and says so. Repro: build/shacl3/repro/R3_*.
engine_limits.RVS: rdf-validate-shacl 0.6.5 implements SHACL Core only: it refuses shapes graphs with sh:sparql constraints ("Cannot find validator for constraint component ...SPARQLConstraintComponent") and inverse paths of non-IRI paths; it is compared on Core-only subsets (sh:sparql constraints and such property shapes removed, pyshacl re-run on the same subset).

shacl_three_engines.about: pyshacl vs shacl-engine (vanilla npm, P1 fix only) vs rdf-validate-shacl (P1 fix) on every station SHACL job and the 10-scene x lab/core bench; cases rdf-validate-shacl refuses are re-run as Core-only subsets. Keys = (focus, shape, severity) multisets. Source: receipts/shacl3.json (build/shacl3/run.sh).

T4.6.note: shacl-engine 1.1.3 collects no value nodes on sh:inversePath [ sh:oneOrMorePath x3do:hasParent ] (a transitive inverse path), so the SHACL Core form of S4 reports a false "no Viewpoint" warning that pyshacl 0.40.2 does not. This disagreement is the lesson of the station; the lab's own S4 is written in SPARQL, where both engines agree (bench jobs).

T4.6:try.note: shacl-engine 1.1.3 collects no value nodes on sh:inversePath [ sh:oneOrMorePath x3do:hasParent ] (a transitive inverse path), so the SHACL Core form of S4 reports a false "no Viewpoint" warning that pyshacl 0.40.2 does not. This disagreement is the lesson of the station; the lab's own S4 is written in SPARQL, where both engines agree (bench jobs).

bench:core:cabinet.note: equal after two stated engine limits of shacl-engine 1.1.3 + Comunica 5.4.1: (1) constraints with GROUP BY (urn:x3d-mcp:shapes:x3d-core#ColorArity) cannot run with a pre-bound $this, so they were dropped in JS and their 0 Python result(s) set aside; (2) the S4 SHACL Core path sh:inversePath [ sh:oneOrMorePath x3do:hasParent ] collects no value nodes in shacl-engine, which adds a false no-viewpoint warning (repro R2). P10 (one sh:sparql per shape) was applied, because unsplit shacl-engine reports a false result when one shape carries two sh:sparql constraints (repro R1). Totals can coincide while keys differ (limits (1) and (2) offset each other); compare key_diff, not counts.
